subject.title: fix(skills): require resolved approval before mutating actions

question: Should these bundled skills always require a second approval of the resolved preview, even when the user’s original request already named the exact destination, content, and action?
rationale: The patch deliberately replaces an existing exact-request exception with an unconditional extra approval round trip across several integrations; code and CLI contracts cannot determine the intended product balance between safety and repeated confirmation.

options.title: Require resolved-preview approval
options.body: Adopt the stricter policy across these skills after fixing the `gog --no-input` wording so approval and CLI interactivity remain separate concepts.

options.title: Keep exact-request preapproval
options.body: Retain the existing exception when the original user message already contains the exact target, content, attachments, and requested action.

options.title: Narrow to ambiguous targets
options.body: Require a new confirmation only when lookup changes or disambiguates the recipient, address, content, event, or file set.

recommendation.title: Require resolved-preview approval
recommendation.body: Adopt the stricter policy across these skills after fixing the `gog --no-input` wording so approval and CLI interactivity remain separate concepts.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected bundled skills primarily document tools owned by `steipete`, and the decision establishes shared behavior across several of those tool workflows.
